summary.name: Shazeus Skills Directory
summary.one_liner: A directory for browsing AI agent skills (SKILL.md instruction packages) by publisher and task, with source repositories, pinned GitHub revisions, license links and install commands.
use_cases: Finding skills for Claude Code, Codex or Cursor
Checking a skill's source repository and license before installing
Browsing agent skills for design, code development, document processing or data work
Copying install commands for a chosen agent skill
summary.what_it_does: The site is a catalog of AI skills, where each skill packages SKILL.md instructions and supporting files so an agent can perform a specific task as a reusable workflow. Skills can be browsed by category or publisher. Each skill's details list the publisher's repository, a pinned GitHub revision, a license link and the file count. The page advises checking the original description and whether a skill includes scripts before installing. It notes that knowing the publisher does not mean a security audit has been done.
notable: Shows pinned GitHub revision for each skill
Lists license link and file count per skill
Provides install command for each target agent
Browsable by category (design, code, documents, data) and by publisher
caveats: Publisher source does not imply a security audit has been performed
Skills may include scripts, so the original description should be checked before installing
